_note: Full-size DIP-14 metal-can crystal oscillator module (ECS-100AX / ECS-2100AX class). Four corner leads in DIP-14 package order: pin 1 OE (internal pullup — floating means RUN), pin 7 GND, pin 8 OUT, pin 14 VCC. A POWERED clock source, not a crystal: params.freq sets the square-wave frequency; OE low or no power tri-states OUT.
